Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
OBSERVED CONTROLS: WASD moves; short taps (~0.25-0.4s) nudge, ~0.9-1.2s holds cover noticeable distance; camera follows character. Space = 'Do Action' (contextual pick), only works with verified in-range target. LMB on world objects selects/examines; hovering shows verb labels. Escape opens Paused menu (Continue, Controls, Settings, Save, Quit). Controls menu: Primary LMB, Secondary RMB, Force Inspect Left Alt, Force Attack Left Ctrl, Do Attack F, Do Action Space, Move WASD; no craft key listed. Tab toggles map.

PICKING (confirmed this run): reliable pattern = approach target from open side, stand roughly level with it (same y), hover the target's own colored pixels until 'Pick X' appears, then Space. Hover labels observed: 'Pick Flower/Sapling/Grass' in range; 'Examine X' when out of range OR when overlapping/standing on the target; empty ground gives no label. Pick range is a narrow ring — stepping too close flips Pick->Examine, requiring stepping back a fraction and re-hovering; this step-back/re-hover loop worked. Trunks dominate hit-testing: tufts beside a pine trunk repeatedly returned 'Examine Evergreen' at any pointer pixel and from several approach angles (right base, south) — grass tufts fused to trunk silhouettes may be effectively unpickable; abandon after a few angles rather than burning daylight. Results: sapling -> twigs into inventory (twig icon); grass tuft -> grass. Each pick consumed/removed the plant.

GROUND DROPS: loose twig-like ground items hovered as 'Examine Sapling'/'Examine' rather than pickup verbs — not reliably harvestable; read the verb and move on. Walk-over auto-collection previously unreliable (uncertain).

CRAFTING UI (still UNRESOLVED): left sidebar category icons (axe ~y0.13, flame 'Light' ~y0.185, more below). Clicking the flame icon expands a vertical recipe column at x~0.088-0.117; bright top tile ~y0.145-0.185 = likely torch (swirl icon), lower tiles dark silhouettes (guess: locked/unaffordable). With ingredients held (2 twigs + 1 grass) hovering/clicking the bright tile produced NO tooltip, NO cost panel, NO visible craft, and pressing Space afterwards had no effect. A detail panel with costs and a Build button was seen ONLY in an earlier session (campfire = 3 cut grass + 2 logs). Craft activation mechanism remains unknown — candidates (unconfirmed guesses): Build button appears only when affordable, keyboard crafting panel (W/S categories, A/D recipes, Space craft), select-tile-then-Space, or a bottom-right scroll/document icon (~0.93,0.89) never explored.

DARKNESS (confirmed lethal, twice): night falls suddenly; screen dims to near-total black with starry vignette, then damage ('OW! Something hit me!'), then a dark-red cracked death overlay with heart icon emptied, ending the run. A small glowing blue circular icon appeared near the day clock (~0.86,0.09) at nightfall — unexplored, possibly light-related.

FAILED STRATEGIES (do not repeat): click-to-harvest; Space out of range or through a trunk; standing on a target; hovering trunk instead of tuft pixels; assuming ground drops are pickable twigs; clicking Light tiles or pressing Space with no feedback and no cost read; wasting daylight debugging craft UI mid-gathering; staying in darkness.

LESSONS FOR NEXT RUN: daylight is a hard deadline. Gather grass and twigs first (saplings are the reliable twig source; grass tufts must be free-standing, not fused to trunks), then resolve the Light/torch recipe cost and activation EARLY and build light well before dusk. Verify every target with hover 'Pick' verb, keep level, step back if 'Examine'. Never remain in total darkness.
